item.title: FIPS 140-3
item.description: This page describes how the OCM CLI and the OCM controller support FIPS 140-3. Since OCM 0.20.0, the binaries and container images are built in FIPS mode. OCM does not ship a separate FIPS variant: the regular binaries and images are built for FIPS, so the same artifact runs in both normal and FIPS-restricted environments.
